title: Parameter Estimation Configurator
text: Generate configuration elements for AC induction motor (ACIM) parameter estimation, 1 output; {Number of pole pairs} sets the number of motor pole pairs, {Rated frequency (Hz)} sets the motor rated frequency, {Nominal motor current (A)} sets the motor nominal current, {Nominal voltage (V)} sets the motor nominal voltage, {Maximum inverter current (A)} sets the maximum measurable current, {Board resistance (ohm)} sets the inverter bridge resistance, {Current sense gain (A/ADC Count)} sets the current per ADC count, {Voltage sense gain (V/ADC Count)} sets the voltage per ADC count, {Measurement time (sec)} sets the time used to measure and average-out, {Open loop ramp time (sec)} sets the time allotted to ramp up frequency, {Estimation time (sec)} sets the time to run R s estimation algorithm, {Vd reference voltage 1 (PU)} sets the first reference voltage for R s estimation, {Vd reference voltage 2 (PU)} sets the second reference voltage for R s, {Frequency 1 as a ratio of rated frequency (PU)} sets the ratio of first injected low frequency over rated, {Frequency 2 as a ratio of rated frequency (PU)} sets the ratio of second injected low frequency over rated, {High Frequency for Lm (Hz)} sets the frequency of third injected signal, {Voltage sweep start value voltage (PU)} sets the initial voltage at which voltage sweep, {Voltage sweep step value voltage (PU)} sets the step size for voltage sweep, {High frequency injection voltage (PU)} sets the voltage of third injected signal, {Current measurement delay (s)} sets the delay in current measurement, {Closed loop duration (sec)} sets the closed-loop motor run duration, {Closed loop speed (RPM)} sets the closed-loop motor speed, {Iq reference current for FOC (PU)} sets the reference current for FOC when estimating J, {Specify current controller gains} sets the pI current controller gains, {Proportional gain}, {Integral gain}, {Speed lower limit for inertia estimation (RPM)} sets the lower speed limit during coast-down and {Parameter estimation sample time (sec)} sets the sample time for parameter. Values come from the instance.
